model.context: all available fixed-snapshot prefix; 36..59 monthly observations

source.excluded_rows: Three 2026-09 PMI rows only; snapshot retained unchanged.

issue_boundary: target statistical month day 20; all context publication dates strictly earlier; target publication strictly later
ridge: Existing frozen StandardScaler+Ridge(alpha=10), lags1/2/3/12 and month sin/cos; past labeled samples only; min24/max120; no tuning.
audit_reference_selection: Minimum development MAE among four; ties use declared baseline order; distinct from unchanged production reference.

metrics.mase_denominator: Mean absolute 12-month difference inside each origin prefix; <=1e-12 undefined, no epsilon replacement or dropping.
metrics.macro: Equal mean of seven per-indicator MASE; do not pool raw percent/index-point MAE across indicators.
metrics.uncertainty: Paired circular 3-month blocks, 2000 resamples, seed42; descriptive 95% only, not significance or unseen-population inference.
metrics.quantiles: Uncalibrated p10/p50/p90; 80% coverage, mean width, pinball at0.1/0.5/0.9; no posthoc calibration.

descriptive_screen.required: All84 complete ordered finite quantiles, defined MASE; challenger macro MASE below each of4 baselines; macro paired95 upper<0 vs development reference; >=5/7 per-indicator MASE wins with1e-8 tolerance.

disk_budget.research_root: Separate D research environment; never modify application .venv or lock
disk_budget.cache_and_temp: D only, including pip and HF caches; no new C artifacts

stops: No execution authorization: stop before download/install/actual backend.
Unresolved full dependency hashes/licenses/security or unsupported CPU adapter: stop before real scoring.
Data SHA/schema/gap/publication/lag mismatch: stop, no imputation or substituted date range.
Resource probe error or budget threshold exceeded: terminate only owned experiment worker and preserve partial log.
Missing/invalid/crossed quantiles, OOM, timeout, worker crash or any failed origin: incomplete result, no selective metric dropping or automatic rerun.
No observed advantage: retain full negative results/model identity and keep production default unchanged.
authorization: Awaiting user approval. Passage of time or fixture success never implies approval.
